integrity: The finite checks are reproducible tests, not universal proofs. The structural theorem is proved directly from the multiplication table and the finite-field factors from isotropic-frame counting. External novelty cannot be guaranteed solely from a finite literature search.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unnormalized adjacency evolution algebras of finite stars and fields in which the number of leaves is nonzero. Counts embedded multiplication-closed linear subspaces, not isomorphism classes. No result in the excluded characteristic-divisibility case, for arbitrary graphs, or for random-walk-normalized graph algebras.
title: Subalgebra lattices and cubic-residue jumps for star evolution algebras
